scores.tell: Drum shells and cymbals have slightly crisp specular edges and a bit more metal sheen than the real cards. The podium's shadow gradient is soft and fits.
The truss and lamp body carry strong, dark metallic gradients. The glow and beam light is more cinematic and darker than the soft real shading.
Soft, broad sheen with gentle turn on the jellyfish bell. There are a few sharp white hot spots on the cap, but they are small. Close to real.
Smooth inflated panels with broad soft highlights and gentle shadow. Matches the real towel and anchor style. The only tell is none.
The truss has hard metallic reflections and glints. The lamp body shows a smooth, deep shadow, and the shadow side is darker than in real cards.
The chair casts a long, defined shadow onto a flat floor. The metal tubes have soft sheen. The floor and chair read as a render, with the lighting a little too realistic.
The AC unit has pale, washed-out shading with weak form contrast. The glow and window-light wash across the wall look like a soft airbrush. The unit has little shadow depth.
Leather has smooth, broad highlights and soft shadow turn, close to the grade-5 saddle. The slightly darker shadow side under the seat flap is the only tell.
The dish has a cool realistic gradient with sharper edge highlights. The base's blue metal has crisp specular points on the rivets, and the sand shadows look realistic.
The calculator has a soft, smooth, inflated form with broad sheen and gentle shadow. One small tell is the slightly sharper edge highlights on the buttons.
